name: SaltyShrimp Shrimp Mineral GH/KH+
description: Remineralizer for hard-water (Neocaridina) shrimp tanks — raises GH and KH together at a published ~dGH:KH ratio of 1.0:0.5. Dosed to a target hardness rather than a fixed per-gram ppm, so values are NOT disclosed.
notes: Raises GH and KH at ~1.0:0.5 (so KH rises about half as fast as GH). Dose to a target with a GH/KH test — community guidance ~0.13-0.18 g/L for 6-8 dGH.
